name: FireGuard
tagline: A simple, friendly GUI for the Linux ufw firewall.
description: See your firewall at a glance and manage it without the command line. FireGuard is a friendly front-end for the Linux Uncomplicated Firewall (ufw): view status and numbered rules, toggle the firewall, add or delete rules from a plain form (with one-click Allow SSH/HTTP/HTTPS presets), set default policies, and allow application profiles. Privileged changes are applied through pkexec — no terminal needed. Fully local; it only drives your own ufw.
